_note: Officially announced parts the Taiwan sheet has not caught up with yet, added straight from the manufacturer's own release so a new set is not missing from the tier list for its first week or two. Appended onto the catalogue in loadCatalogue(). A relative `img` (no leading slash) points at a locally committed asset under public/, prefixed with BASE_URL at load time.
_when_the_sheet_catches_up: Delete the entry by hand. loadCatalogue() only steps aside on an exact id+cat match, and an entry written before the real data exists rarely guesses that exactly — UX-21 shipped here as UX-21-1 against the sheet's zero-padded UX-21-01, and every blade showed twice. Matching loosely is not the fix: the sheet carries `NR` and `Nr` as two different bits, on different grades, so folding case or padding together would silently merge genuinely separate parts. Copy the sheet's id format exactly (UX-21-01, not UX-21-1) and treat any entry here as temporary.
